claims.title: Gaussian three-level dimension law and supplied quantum formation separation

quoted_fields.interface: Input is a finite number of bosonic modes with Gaussian characteristic function,finite covariance and arbitrary finite first moments. Use P01=|0><0|+|1><1|,an isometry V01 to two output levels,and a COUNTED orthogonal erasure |e>. For fixed0<kappa<=1,Phi_kappa(X)=kappa*V01*P01*X*P01*V01^dagger+Tr[(I-kappa*P01)X]|e><e|. Apply the same product channel without covariance learning,unknown-displacement correction or state-adaptive filtering. Fixed parties may contain multiple modes;each k-mode party retains dimension3^k.
quoted_fields.failure: Qualitative entanglement retention does not preserve its amount,guarantee efficient readout or uniform noise tolerance. Fixed squeezing with growing displacement approaches total erasure. Arbitrarily weak qutrit depolarization xi can erase entanglement for0<lambda<=xi^2/18,with channel diamond perturbation<=2xi. Gaussian promise essential;non-Gaussian(|22>+|33>)/sqrt2 maps to product erasure. Fixed-partition claims do not establish preservation of genuine multipartite entanglement or convex mixtures over varying partitions. Qubit minimality excludes centered-only,state-adaptive,multiple-copy,correlated-LOCC or uncounted-herald-register variants. The optical Alice-Bob2|2 example is not every-cut PPT/separability. No blind-detector interface is inherited. Formation cost is supplied resource,not net consumption of an extensive returned catalyst;zero Bell yield is not Bell locality. Native-axis metrology failure is contract-specific;failed Bell searches remain searches.
